settings.label: Is joining really free?
settings.text: Yes. Every account earns points from day one, with no fee.

settings.label: Where do points come from?
settings.text: Orders, product reviews, referrals, following us on social and uploading in-store receipts.

settings.label: When do points expire?
settings.text: After twelve months without an order or any other activity.

settings.label: What happens if I return something?
settings.text: The points from that purchase come off your balance.

settings.label: Do auto-ship orders earn points?
settings.text: Yes, every shipment counts the same as a normal order.

settings.label: Can I use points with a promo code?
settings.text: You can, in the same checkout.

settings.label: Is there a limit on points?
settings.text: No cap on points from purchases or reviews.

settings.label: How long does tier status last?
settings.text: Your level holds for a full year after you reach it.

settings.label: How do in-store receipts work?
settings.text: Upload a photo of the receipt and points appear within ten business days.
